Grade: Grade 5
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Bible
Topic 2.3: King Solomon the wise ruler

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: King Solomon the wise ruler

Try this
